description.value:
The Kohaku clan are swift and agile shinobi, known for their "Sonic" bloodline which allows them to move at incredible speeds, often appearing as a blur to the naked eye. They are masters of hit-and-run tactics, using their speed to overwhelm opponents before they can react. They are close allies of the Tsuchigumo clan.

Source: Mechanics/Character_Options/Occupations/Homebrew/Kohaku Clan.md

Category: Homebrew

Prerequisite: Age 8+

Class Skills: Select 2 from Balance, Sleight of Hand, Taijutsu.

Feat: Select one from Advanced Bloodline (Sonic), Improved Initiative, Run, Genin, Dodge.

Wealth Bonus Increase: +1

Reputation Bonus Increase: +1

Affiliation: You require 1 less success to learn Kohaku Hijutsu techniques.
